name: Mug
description: An ample wheel-thrown mug designed for coffee and tea lovers alike. The curved body and handle design give the form a distinctive silhouette while maintaining a comfortable grip in hand.Each mug carries subtle variation and layered detail. Crafted from durable stoneware, it’s a functional yet expressive piece made to elevate your daily coffee or tea ritual. Cared for well, it will warm your hands for many winters to come.
